name: theme-switcher
title: Theme Switcher
description: Switch your rice (Gruvbox/Nord/Tokyo Night/Catppuccin/Kanagawa/Everforest/Rose Pine/Zedokai/Ayu/Kanso) across Ghostty, Zed, borders, and wallpaper, with a full live preview as you browse. Cmd+Shift+W on any theme to change its wallpaper (5-6 per mode); from there, Cmd+Shift+D pulls in more from Wallhaven and Cmd+Shift+A adds your own (one or more local files at once, or a URL).
author: cameronboyle

commands.name: switch-theme
commands.title: Switch Theme
commands.description: Pick a theme family with a live preview; Cmd+Shift+W to change its wallpaper

commands.name: sync-wallpaper
commands.title: Sync Wallpaper to All Spaces
commands.description: Force the current theme's wallpaper onto every Space (assign this its own hotkey in Raycast preferences)
